# delivers to account

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:deliversToAccount`](gmeow-deliversToAccount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/deliversToAccount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an email address to the online account it delivers to — the seam joining an address (held by an agent) to the account a message resides in.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) -> [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:deliversToAccount`](gmeow-deliversToAccount.md) from [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) to [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md), [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to cross from an email address (held by an agent) to the [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) whose mailbox receives its messages — the contacts→accounts seam.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating the address with the account it delivers to (the address is a contact point, the account is where messages reside) and avoid using it for non-email channels.

### How to use

- Link the [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) to its delivery [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md); the address carries the agent's tenure while the account anchors the stored messages.

### Examples

- ex:lillithEmail [`gmeow:deliversToAccount`](gmeow-deliversToAccount.md) ex:lillithMailbox.
